claim.quote: Measurement of the Coherent Elastic Neutrino-Nucleus Scattering Cross Section on CsI by COHERENT

date.note: Published 2022-08-19; first submitted to arXiv 2021-10-14, revised 2022-06-02.
date.quote: Measurement of the Coherent Elastic Neutrino-Nucleus Scattering Cross Section on CsI by COHERENT

key_value.note: Full CsI[Na] dataset before detector decommissioning; more than double the exposure of the 2017 observation, with an improved quenching model.
key_value.quote: cross section to be (165^{+30}_{-25})x10^{-40} cm^2, consistent with the standard model

key_value_text.quote: measuring the weak mixing angle as sin^2(theta_W) = 0.220^{+0.028}_{-0.026}
key_value_text.value: Weak mixing angle sin^2(theta_W) = 0.220 (+0.028/-0.026) at ~50 MeV^2 momentum transfer, alongside constraints on non-standard interactions and a test of lepton flavor universality using the neutrino beam's timing structure

name: Measurement of the Coherent Elastic Neutrino-Nucleus Scattering Cross Section on CsI by COHERENT

significance.note: The abstract fetched this session does not restate a single overall significance figure for the full dataset (the original 2017 observation's 6.7 sigma is superseded but not re-quoted here); left uncertain rather than inferred.

summary.plain: COHERENT's most precise look yet at neutrinos scattering off caesium-iodide nuclei, using the full dataset from the same crystal before it was retired, sharp enough to measure a key parameter of the Standard Model directly at low energy.
summary.technical: Full CsI[Na] dataset (13.99 GWhr integrated beam power) before detector decommissioning, more than double the exposure of the 2017 observation with an improved quenching model: cross section (165+30/-25)x10^-40 cm^2, weak mixing angle sin^2(theta_W)=0.220(+0.028/-0.026) at ~50 MeV^2, plus constraints on non-standard interactions and lepton flavor universality from the beam's timing structure.

title: Measurement of the Coherent Elastic Neutrino-Nucleus Scattering Cross Section on CsI by COHERENT
why_it_matters: A precision CEvNS cross-section measurement at low momentum transfer gives one of the cleanest low-energy determinations of the weak mixing angle and tightens constraints on non-standard neutrino interactions relevant to reactor and solar neutrino physics, dark matter direct detection backgrounds, and supernova-neutrino modeling.
